info.name: Campaigns API
info.description: Postman collection for the Campaigns API (local server)

exec: pm.test('Response is an array', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(json)).to.be.true; });
// assert each item has required fields and types

(function() { var json = pm.response.json(); if (Array.isArray(json)) { json.forEach(function(item, idx) { pm.test('Item ' + idx + ' has required fields', function() { pm.expect(item).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('clientName'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('startDate'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('endDate'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('description'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('budget'); }); pm.test('Item ' + idx + ' types are correct', function() { pm.expect(typeof item.id).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof item.name).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof item.clientName).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof item.startDate).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof item.endDate).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof item.description).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof item.budget).to.eql('number'); }); }); } })();

try { var req = pm.request.body && pm.request.body.raw ? JSON.parse(pm.request.body.raw) : null; if (req) { pm.test('Response name matches request', function () { pm.expect(json.name).to.eql(req.name); }); pm.test('Response budget matches request', function () { pm.expect(json.budget).to.eql(req.budget); }); } } catch(e) {}

pm.test('Response includes required fields with correct types', function () { pm.expect(typeof json.id).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof json.name).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof json.clientName).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof json.startDate).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof json.endDate).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof json.description).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(typeof json.budget).to.eql('number'); });
pm.test('Response is an array', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(json)).to.be.true; });

item.name: Get Campaign by ID
item.description: Uses `{{lastCampaignId}}` set by the Create Campaign test script

exec: pm.test('Response id matches environment id', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('lastCampaignId')); });

pm.test('Response has required fields and types', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(typeof json.id).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(typeof json.name).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('clientName'); pm.expect(typeof json.clientName).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('startDate'); pm.expect(typeof json.startDate).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('endDate'); pm.expect(typeof json.endDate).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('description'); pm.expect(typeof json.description).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('budget'); pm.expect(typeof json.budget).to.eql('number'); });

item.name: Delete Campaign by ID
item.description: Uses `{{lastCampaignId}}` set by the Create Campaign test script

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('baseUrl') + '/api/campaigns/' + pm.environment.get('lastCampaignId'), method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('GET after delete returns 404', function () { pm.expect(err).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(404); }); });
